text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I wonder if my nose has stopped bleeding…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ugh… Why am I always smacking into walls like that?
…annhaus… you hear…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Huh?
Matikanetannhauser… Can you hear me? I'm speaking directly… into your mind…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Uwaaah! Wh-wh-what's going on?! Who are you?!
Tis I, the god of nosebleeds.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: The god of nosebleeds?!

text_block_list.name: God of Nosebleeds
text_block_list.text: Your nosebleeds have shed enough blood to fill an entire bucket, and so I have been summoned.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: That much?! I guess I do run into things a lot…

text_block_list.name: God of Nosebleeds
text_block_list.text: Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Is that really something to be happy about?

text_block_list.name: God of Nosebleeds
text_block_list.text: Of course it is. Your nosebleeds are proof that you continue to run at full tilt, with no fear of crashing into things.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, I see! When you put it like that, nosebleeds don't seem so bad!

text_block_list.name: God of Nosebleeds
text_block_list.text: Please continue to run at top speed. I'll be cheering for you.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll do my best! Ei, ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: …Huh? Did I fall asleep?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Oh, it was just a dream. Figures. A god of nosebleeds—how silly.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: But… if nosebleeds are proof that I'm always running my hardest…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I guess it wasn't such a bad dream!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From that day forward, Matikanetannhauser's running becomes even more refined.
